notes: Fresh second-blind set authored without the gate code. Family A: Maxwell gemma4:12b. Family B: Juanito qwen2.5:3b (little:latest / Spark was unavailable: unknown model architecture spark2_5). Code-manifest pin a584de3d38143100bed9dc2a0363957cb91d7e026cf62d9a9817c168740d5336 was posted on CREW-CHANNEL before generation. Packing extracted missing poNumber from invoiceDocument, filled missing supplierName from the public register, stripped setup rows the written policy would have refused, and annotated expected codes from the written check order. Author invoices, emails, merchant ids, amounts and invoice ids were not rewritten.
